name: task-operations-validation-local-use
body: The task_operations_validation unit test reaches the pub(crate) validator via a function-local `use crate::plan_cmd::authoring::{TaskOperation, validate_task_operations};` because src/plan_cmd/mod.rs carries explicit #[cfg(test)] pub(crate) use re-exports for other narrow-visibility helpers but not this one. Limit: a function-local use instead of an unqualified call. Upgrade to an unqualified/super::* call if mod.rs later re-exports the validator.
